item.title: Rams cut K Harrison Mevis after 2 misses vs Bills, sign ex-Saints K Blake Grupe, AP source says
item.description: The Los Angeles Rams have cut kicker Harrison Mevis one day after he missed two field-goal attempts in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Buffalo Bills, a person with knowledge of the decision says

item.title: Bears DE Montez Sweat suspended 2 games for violating NFL’s performance-enhancing substances policy
item.description: Chicago Bears defensive end Montez Sweat has been suspended for two games for violating the NFL’s performance-enhancing substances policy

item.title: Supreme Court will review asylum case of Nigerian man who cooked meals for terrorist leaders
item.description: The Supreme Court has agreed to consider if a Nigerian man is ineligible for asylum because he cooked meals at a camp for leaders of a group the U.S. government considers to be a terrorist organization

item.description: “La Bola Negra,” a $15 million Spanish queer epic, is expected to challenge “The Odyssey” for best picture

item.title: Dolly Parton's nephew denies threatening to harm her estate, pushes back against restraining order

item.title: A new bridge linking China and North Korea will open more than a decade late
item.description: A new bridge linking China and North Korea is set to open Thursday after more than a decade of delay

item.title: Kroger to lay off 3,000 corporate employees over 3 years as it leans into artificial intelligence
item.description: Grocery store chain Kroger says it will lay off 3,000 corporate employees over the next three years as it ramps up its use of artificial intelligence to streamline operations
